title: GTA 6's First TV Ad Cuts The Spicy Shower Scenes
summary: But, we get a few extra milliseconds of new footage, so that's something
text: GTA 6's First TV Ad Cuts The Spicy Shower Scenes Skip to content Kotaku Latest Entertainment Reviews News Tips & Guides Games Downloads Deals News GTA 6 ‘s First TV Ad Cuts The Spicy Shower Scenes But, we get a few extra milliseconds of new footage, so that's something Grand Theft Auto 6 GTA 6 NBA Rockstar Games Trailer By Zack Zwiezen Published October 21, 2026 | Comments ( 4 ) | 𝕏 Copied! © Rockstar Games / Kotaku Last night, the first television advertisements for the upcoming Grand Theft Auto 6 were broadcast during some NBA basketball games. And it’s basically just the launch trailer from last week , but with a few of the spicier bits featuring sex in the shower completely missing. On October 20, as spotted by numerous people on social media, a slightly modified version of the recently released GTA 6 launch trailer was broadcast during opening night of the NBA season. Specifically, people online saw the ad while watching a New York Knicks and Philadelphia 76ers game. Others reported seeing the ad, or a similar version, during a Pistons/Celtics game and a Thunder/Spurs game that same night. The full GTA 6 Tv commercial shown shown during the NBA game between New York Knicks and Philadelphia 76ers. pic.twitter.com/zua7JPuNcu - GTA 6 Info (@GTASixInfo) October 21, 2026 In the version of the ad seen above , you’ll notice that while the first shower scene is still included, the other two moments are missing. It seems that these moments were a bit too spicy for broadcast television. Guns, explosions, robbery, and other criminal mischief and violence are fine. Just don’t show any bare legs bumping around in a shower for a few frames. Some GTA superfans out there also spotted a few very, very minor differences between this new ad and the launch trailer . The first GTA 6 commercial aired on NBC Sports, featuring the launch trailer but with some changes: – Cut shower shots, resulting in other shots being a bit longer – Longer plane shot – Longer Jason and Lucia shot – Xbox logo completely removed due to the deal with PlayStation pic.twitter.com/o6qc4dGZab - GTA 6 Countdown ⏳ (@GTAVI_Countdown) October 21, 2026 It seems like a few extra frames of footage were included after Jason jokingly punches Lucia’s arm. And a few more frames were included in the bit where Lucia jumps off a truck and onto a plane’s landing gear. This doesn’t really reveal anything new, but there you go, fresh footage of GTA 6. I suspect this same ad will show up during the upcoming Miami Heat game that is being directly sponsored by GTA 6 and which will feature unique uniforms and more. For many, seeing GTA 6 ‘s launch trailer appear on TV while watching a basketball game made it feel a lot more real. “Seeing it on a proper TV spot during a big game makes it feel real now,” said one person. Another mentioned that seeing the date and the ad on their living room TV suddenly made it clear that GTA 6 is only a few weeks away . After a decade of rumors, leaks, reports, and delays, the long wait is nearly over. Grand Theft Auto 6 arrives on November 19. 🕹️ Level up your inbox Don’t miss the latest reviews, news and tips.
